title: A screen reader says nothing about the share picture before it is shared
what: The share sheet shows a preview of the workout, report or before/after picture, but the drawn picture carries no spoken description. A blind or low-vision member hears nothing about what is on the picture (title, kilos, records, gym name) before sending it to friends.
expected: The preview reads out a short summary of what the picture shows, for example the workout name, day, kilos lifted and records.
fix_line: Give the preview a spoken summary built from the same words drawn on the picture

items.reason: this area holds rules, words and picture drawing only; no button or tappable view is drawn here (they live in tracker components and screens), and no phone screenshot is in the inputs
